subject: german
title: Subjects & Classroom Verbs
welcome_lead: Mathe, Deutsch and what you do at school.
meta_desc: KS3 German: school subjects and basic classroom verbs.

walkthroughs.body_html: Subjects: Mathe, Deutsch, Englisch, Geschichte, Erdkunde (geography), Sport. All capitalised — they're nouns.
Ich lerne = I learn. Ich schreibe = I write. Ich lese = I read. Three of the most useful school verbs.
'Ich mag Mathe' = 'I like maths'. Ich mag = I like. 'Mathe ist mein Lieblingsfach' = 'Maths is my favourite subject'.

mcqs.q: In 'Heute gehe ich ins Kino', why does 'gehe' come second?
options: German is a V2 language - the conjugated verb is the second element in main clauses.
Heute is always followed by a verb.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I like school because the teachers are nice' in German?
options: Ich mag die Schule, weil sind die Lehrer nett.
Ich mag die Schule, weil die Lehrer sind nett.
Ich mag die Schule, weil die Lehrer nett sind.
Heute is always followed by a verb.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I get up early' using 'aufstehen'?
options: Heute is always followed by a verb.
